name: instance
meaning: An object created from a class, with its own instance fields.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: constructor
meaning: Initialization code selected when an object is created, with the class name and no return type.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: encapsulation
meaning: Control access to representation through operations that maintain a class’s rules.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: final binding
meaning: A variable assigned only as permitted during initialization; a final reference does not freeze its object.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: overriding
meaning: A subclass supplies an implementation of an inherited instance method with a compatible signature.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: abstract class
meaning: A class that cannot be instantiated directly and may require subclasses to implement abstract methods.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: interface contract
meaning: A common set of operations that implementing classes must provide with compatible signatures.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: record
meaning: A data-carrier class whose declared components determine generated accessors and value-oriented methods.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: sealed hierarchy
meaning: A type hierarchy whose permitted direct subtypes are explicitly controlled.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: enum
meaning: A type with a fixed declared set of named instances.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: equals/hashCode contract
meaning: Logically equal objects must have equal hash codes; a collision does not imply equality.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: type parameter
meaning: A placeholder type used to define a family of type-checked classes or methods.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: generic bound
meaning: A type restriction that makes specified operations available inside generic code.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: bounded wildcard
meaning: An unknown type with an upper or lower bound that controls safe generic reads and writes.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: unboxing
meaning: Convert a wrapper reference to its primitive value; null cannot be unboxed.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: checked exception
meaning: An exception type subject to Java’s compile-time catch-or-declare requirement.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: try-with-resources
meaning: A statement that automatically closes declared resources when its block exits.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: Optional
meaning: A container representing either one non-null value or no value.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: type pattern
meaning: A runtime type test that binds a variable of the tested type on a successful match.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.

name: composition
meaning: Build behavior by holding and using collaborator objects rather than inheriting all behavior.
context: Java language/API semantics; Java25 LTS core.
